_readme: S645, 2026-11-13. Read 7 (run 43362895655, 6 loads): the program grid lists 72 areas, not 77, each at /academics/explore-our-programs/<slug>, and the paid read's index step read all 72 (areas 72, areas_failed 0). So the 115 programs with no page sit in areas the step read and took no eLumen link from: Dental Assisting, Dental Hygiene, Early Childhood Education, Culinary Arts, Kinesiology, Music, Philosophy, Spanish, Japanese, Russian, Dance, Drama, English as a Second Language, Psychology, Sociology, English, History, Plumbing. This read loads six of those area pages and one area that gave its programs (Administration of Justice, read 3) with every award, catalog and eLumen link shown, to see how a silent area links its awards: another catalog year, eLumen's program/<slug> with a slash, a dvc.edu page between, a PDF, or no link at all. No model call. Answered by run 43363340544 (7 loads): Administration of Justice links its ten awards at program,<slug>; the six silent areas link theirs at program/<slug>, the slash form, on the same DVC2026-2027Catalog (Dental Assisting 3, Music 2, Psychology 1, Spanish 3, Kinesiology 8, Early Childhood Education 8). The step's program_links names the comma form only, so the index took none of them; el_index_link_named now takes either form.

questions.award_links: Where does each award an area page names link (its host, the eLumen catalog slug and separator, a dvc.edu page, a PDF), and how does a silent area's link differ from Administration of Justice's?
